jobs.description: Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

jobs.occupation: Assembly Worker Canon Production Printing Venlo (229528)
jobs.description:
One of the biggest companies in the print industry is looking for you! Do you already know who we are talking about? None other than Canon of course! Canon Production & Printing is looking for assembly workers to put printers together. In return, you will receive a gross starting salary of €15.81 per hour and you can even get a direct contract with Canon! Want to know more about this job? Then read on quickly and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for assembly workers in Venlo for Canon.

As an assembly worker, you will assemble printers based on manuals. Your main tasks will be:

    - Assembling printers based on manuals
    
- Requesting parts from colleagues in the Logistics department
    
- Using technical insight to connect the right printer parts with each other

What's in it for you

    - Gross starting salary from €15.81 per hour
    
- Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer (starting from 10 kilometers one way)
    
- Temporary employment contract via Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract with Canon if you perform well
    
- Free development opportunities via the Manpower Academy, where you can follow more than 200 online courses
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Year-end bonus (13th month)

    - Minimum MBO working and thinking level
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week
    
- Proven affinity with technology (this can come from work experience, education, or your hobbies)
    
- Good command of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written, is required due to work tasks and safety on the shop floor

Is this your new job and do you want to be considered? Then apply today before the vacancy closes and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

Samenvatting Step into the fast-paced world of logistics as an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area?. This role gives you hands-on experience, growth opportunities, and a supportive team environment. Using a handheld scanner, you make sure every item is picked accurately and efficiently. You’ll also help pack orders, label shipments, and occasionally assist with unloading goods from trucks. - Assisting with unloading deliveries and organizing goods

You work Monday to Friday, with shifts between 7:00 and 16:00. Some flexibility during busy periods may be required.
Over het bedrijf
Within this logistics company in Zoetermeer area, you’ll find a team that values efficiency, reliability, and good communication. The company specializes in fast and accurate order processing for clients across the region, using modern systems and a well-organized warehouse. You’ll work alongside colleagues who are supportive and eager to help new team members settle in. The atmosphere is open, with a mix of experienced staff and newcomers, and there’s always music playing to keep the energy up. If you’re looking for a place where you can learn, grow, and be part of a close-knit team, this is it.
Wat wij vragen- Own housing in the Netherlands required. No accommodation provided.
- No previous experience required – full training will be provided
- Basic knowledge of Dutch, Englis

Samenvatting Ready to roll up your sleeves and get moving in a dynamic warehouse environment in Amsterdam? From loading and unloading to sorting packages, every day is an opportunity to stay active and energized. Whether you're handling lightweight parcels or heavier loads, this job lets you show your strength and speed. It's the perfect fit for those who enjoy teamwork and a physically engaging role. Ready for the next step in your production career? Become an Operator at DeliBarn in Wijchen and work with modern production lines, machines and high-quality meat products. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for a motivated, reliable, and responsible Operator who enjoys working with machines and production processes and takes pride in delivering high-quality work. You: Speak and understand English Are willing to work in a two-shift system: 06:00 AM – 03:00 PM / 03:00 PM – 12:00 AM Have basic technical knowledge and an interest in machines and production processes Have a strong focus on hygiene, food safety, quality, and safety Are comfortable working in a cooled production environment Are flexible and willing to work on Saturdays and public holidays when required Wat bieden wij je? At DeliBarn, you will join an innovative, international, and growing food production company where you can build a long-term career. We offer: Starting gross hourly wage of €17.16 14% shift allowance on top of every worked hour in the two-shift system Additional allowance for working in a chilled environment of €0.10 – €0.62 per hour 25 holidays 8% holiday allowance Travel allowance Safety shoes and work clothing provided Flexible working opportunities on Saturdays and public holidays A long-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract Training and guidance on the job A modern and professional working environment Opportunities to develop your technical skills Career and growth opportunities within the organization Functieomschrijving As an Operator, you work independently and keep a close eye on the entire production process. You know when adjustments are needed and take action when something is not running as it should. Your responsibilities include: Operating production lines in the slicing department Receiving and checking incoming raw materials Supplying and removing products during the production process Setting up, adjusting and starting production lines and machines

Changing over machines and production lines when required Monitoring the production process and making adjustments when necessary Identifying and solving minor production disruptions Performing visual inspections and quality checks Making sure products meet the required quality standards Following hygiene, food safety, health and safety procedures Keeping your work area clean, safe and organized You’ll work in a cooled and highly hygienic production environment. Accuracy and responsibility are important, but so is teamwork. You’ll work independently while staying in close contact with your colleagues and keeping an overview of the production process. Where will you work? You will work at DeliBarn in Wijchen, a modern and important production location within the organization. DeliBarn is a leading specialist in the Benelux in service slicing and premium meat products, including ham, salami, and poultry products. Every day, high-quality meat products are produced, sliced, and packaged for major retailers and foodservice customers throughout Europe. The production site in Wijchen is equipped with advanced slicing and packaging technology and modern machinery. These technologies allow DeliBarn to process products efficiently while meeting strict food safety and quality standards. Within DeliBarn, innovation, quality, teamwork, and personal development are highly valued. The company continues to invest in modern technology and efficient production processes, giving employees the opportunity to learn, develop their skills, and grow within the organization. Apply today and become part of the DeliBarn team in Wijchen. Your next career step could start here!

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.
